scope: Initial design requirements retained below; actual results and unsupported comparison are qualified by the supplement and README.

cases.decision: Close the north stitch, then secure the opposite terrace instead of following the new frontier blindly.
requirements: At least two distinct capture transactions.
Observe contour topology revision and its actual route/mode after each capture. An idle/rejoining patrol must be reported honestly, not called active patrol.
Save before a changed frontier, after each of the first two captures, and after the patrol starts moving again; exact suffix restoration.

cases.decision: Claim the rover cell, recognize its warning, and take the outer return while the rover becomes active.
requirements: Actual rover.warning then rover.activated from terrace-rover.
Show movement while avoiding the claimed-ground actor; demonstrate a real actor-caused loss separately.
Save during warning and after activation; no activation state injection.

cases.decision: Use a genuine failed cut, then collect the optional life rather than pretending it erased the failure.
requirements: Exactly one actual livesLost before collection; pickup gain is actual and at most one.
After the extra-life pickup, livesLost remains one; eventual win cannot satisfy clean-life/Precision.
Record actual loss reason. This self-contact proposal is not evidence of actor-specific contact.

cases.decision: Compare a cross-sector stitch with an outside-first circuit, watching both directions at each new frontier.
requirements: Actual distinct capture cells/returns, not only timestamps or mirrored commands.
Both wheel-clockwise and wheel-counterclockwise move from their initial position; preserve their opposite authored directions.
Save while both patrols have moved and after a frontier handoff.

cases.decision: Turn toward an existing safe return during the interceptor warning rather than waiting for an arbitrary duration.
requirements: Actual head-intercept warning then commitment and cooldown from wheel-interceptor.
Record available return distance and actual cut closing during the warning. No automatic guarantee that every warning is escapable.
Optional enemy-slow demonstration must prove collection, fixed effect interval and expiry; ordinary wins must avoid the pickup.
Separately record a real contour and interceptor loss; actor/line-impact attribution must come from events.

cases.decision: Claim the lower bay, actively reposition along the western route, then repair a real eroded cell.
requirements: Actual erosion.warning, cells.eroded, and later cells.claimed containing at least one of those exact indices.
Independent union of all claimed cell indices equals uniqueClaimedCount; score equals that count times pointsPerCell for these objective-free layouts.
Erosion does not change prior unique credit; re-claiming old cells cannot score them twice.
Save during warning, after erosion and after recapture; preserve target/cooldown/topology data through the real session API.

cases.decision: Use the open right corridor to secure the outside before repairing the bay.
requirements: A distinct legal win with fewer eroded cells than the repair demonstration, measured from actual events; do not enforce an invented zero-erosion result.
No stationary wait padding to obtain the comparison.
Extra-life cove is optional. Confirm erosion protection around current player/departure from observed events, without changing protection rules.
Separately record an actual eroder contact loss and terminal game-over controls.

laterAdmission: First24 ordinary Scout routes must pass before these unproven demonstrations are refined.
Preserve seven recipe bytes; explicitly inspect speed/radius/passive differences before selecting affected additional class contexts.
Loss/recovery/game-over and mechanic demonstrations are separate from ordinary wins.
No art, native play, campaign production approval or release adoption is established by this file.

results.warningEscape: Cancellation at tick132 before scheduled169 commitment; separate actor-loss cases observe commitment/cooldown.
results.extraLife: Four actual wins after gain1 retain livesLost1 and cannot be clean Gold.
results.outsideErosionComparison: Fewer eroded cells is true in Standard (north2/south1), not Gentle (north2/south2). Keep the observed equal Gentle result; no universal fewer-erosion claim.
deferred: Additional six selectable classes and additional seeds.
Independent demonstration of every erosion protection anchor.
Native readability, art, human challenge calibration, production approval and runtime/catalog/release adoption.
